scope: Post-r1 actual failure repair: Linux root-controller namespace permission and bounded fixed-code supervisor diagnostics. No current full business runtime PASS is claimed.
actualFailureRootCause: Owner uid1000 cannot read /proc/<root-controller>/ns/mnt; previous supervise called the root-only Task.namespace guard. Actual Linux old EACCES and repaired owner binding PASS are separately recorded.
change: Root parent retains full namespace guard. Owner supervisor verifies protected lease/namespace.identity, unreused root PID/startTime, exact controller argv and own namespace; no cross-uid namespace link read. Parent only preserves an allowlisted fixed supervisorFailureCode from a protected <=8192-byte supervisor log, never raw lines.

validation.additionalCases: Root-owned controller without privileged namespace-link reads; PID/UID/argv/lease mismatch refusals; malformed namespace records; fixed diagnostic filtering and dead-supervisor group rollback.

actualLinuxPermissionEvidence.limitation: That isolated permission evidence retains its own then-current 45-case test source digest; one additional dead-supervisor controller regression brings the current suite to 46.
